claims.statement: The implemented scalar, O(2) matter and (diagonal) metric field equations of the UET parent code follow from the Theory Card action UET-PARENT-ACTION-001.
claims.note: Mathematical consistency only; says nothing about whether nature follows this action.

claims.statement: epsilon is not an independent coupling of the parent action: in canonical variables xi_c and m_psi are epsilon-independent, lambda_psi ~ 1/epsilon and g_c ~ sqrt(epsilon), so epsilon = 0 is a degenerate point rather than a continuous GR limit.

Assuming ordinary matter couples minimally to the Jordan metric, the UET parent action maps onto the Damour-Esposito-Farese class with alpha0 = 0 and beta0 = -2 xi_c around psi0 = 0, so PPN gamma - 1 = 0 at that background.
claims.note: Mathematical mapping only; confrontation with binary-pulsar data is W6 (Test Card T001).

claims.statement: Binary-pulsar timing (ZFKSW22) excludes the UET non-minimal coupling interval that maps to the analysed DEF scalarization range, for a scalar light compared with the binary orbits; the parent action stays compatible for other xi_c.
claims.note: CONSTRAINT (not a prediction): xi_c in [2.0, 2.4] excluded for m_psi <= 2.5e-18 eV; L2 promotion approved by the author 2026-11-09.

claims.statement: In the layer-3 model, systems that disappear when their free-energy store F is exhausted at burn power P give steady abundance N* = b F/P (Little's law), replicator dynamics with fitness aR - P/F as an identity, and selection of the lowest R* = P/(a F) under a shared resource, without imposed payoffs.
